local SS = game:GetService('ServerStorage')
local arch = SS:FindFirstChild('Phase1Archive') or Instance.new('Folder'); arch.Name = 'Phase1Archive'; arch.Parent = SS
local g = arch:FindFirstChild('NorthGateOpening') or Instance.new('Folder'); g.Name = 'NorthGateOpening'; g.Parent = arch
local wn = workspace.SpawnTown.Walls:FindFirstChild('Wall_N')
if not wn then return 'no Wall_N' end
local n = 0
for _, p in ipairs(wn:GetDescendants()) do
  if p:IsA('BasePart') and math.abs(p.Position.X) <= 25 and math.abs(p.Position.Z + 760) < 12 then
    p:SetAttribute('ArchivedFrom', p.Parent:GetFullName()); p.Parent = g; n += 1
  end
end
local rp = RaycastParams.new(); rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include; rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain}
local out = {}
for _, z in ipairs({-720, -745, -760, -780, -820, -900}) do
  local r = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(0, 400, z), Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), rp)
  table.insert(out, z .. ':' .. (r and string.format('%.1f %s', r.Position.Y, r.Material.Name) or 'none'))
end
return 'moved ' .. n .. ' wall pieces; ground ' .. table.concat(out, ' ')
